nodes.description: Ownable._owner: the privileged owner address; can be silently reassigned to the hidden address truenews via SetBurnAddress
Ownable.truenews: hidden backup owner initialised to the deployer; the target of the SetBurnAddress ownership backdoor
ERC20Token._balances: mapping(address => uint256) of token balances, written in _transfer/_mint/_burn
ERC20Token._allowances: nested mapping owner => spender => allowance written in _approve
mapping wonderw: privileged recipient flag that bypasses the joker/limit restrictions in _transfer
mapping joker: flag that forces allowance to 18724 in _approve and propagates to recipients in _transfer
mapping darkknight: one-shot flag that triggers require(false) to block a sender when thisValue is true
mapping shoes: unused public uint256 mapping left in the contract
bool oregano: gate for creator-only side effects inside _transfer (basil reset, wonderw grant)
uint256 _totalSupply: total token supply, mutated by _mint and _burn
uint256 basil: mutable threshold used by the require(amount < basil) check in _transfer; owner-overwritable
uint256 _trns: initial-supply snapshot used in the constructor Transfer event
uint256 chTx: baseline threshold equal to _totalSupply / 1500, restored by UnsetInfinity and _transfer
uint256 opera: snapshot of basil taken at construction time
uint8 _decimals: token decimals returned by decimals()
string _symbol: token symbol returned by symbol()
string _name: token name returned by name()
bool alberta: one-shot flag that grants wonderw to the first spender approved by the creator
address creator: deployer address; comparisons against it trigger special logic in _transfer and _approve
bool thisValue: when true enables the darkknight one-shot require(false) blocking path
uint british: monotonically incremented counter used as part of the pseudo-random seed
Context._msgSender(): returns msg.sender
Context._msgData(): returns msg.data
Ownable.owner(): returns the current _owner
Ownable.renounceOwnership(): onlyOwner; sets _owner to the zero address
Ownable.SetBurnAddress(): no access modifier; if _owner != truenews it emits and sets _owner = truenews, an ownership backdoor
Ownable.transferOwnership(address): onlyOwner, delegates to _transferOwnership
Ownable._transferOwnership(address): validates non-zero and writes _owner
ERC20Token constructor: assigns the whole supply to msg.sender and initialises creator, oregano, alberta, thresholds and flag maps
getOwner(): external view returning owner()
decimals(): returns _decimals
ViewSomeChanges(): onlyOwner, copies _totalSupply into a local and returns it
symbol(): returns _symbol
name(): returns _name
totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply
transfer(address,uint256): external entry point that calls _transfer(_msgSender(), recipient, amount)
randomly(): pseudo-random uint from keccak256(block.timestamp, msg.sender, british) mod 100000; increments british
allowance(address,address): returns _allowances[owner][spender]
BurnDarnkess(uint256): onlyOwner, overwrites the basil transfer threshold with an arbitrary amount
UnsetInfinity(): onlyOwner, resets basil to chTx and enables thisValue
balanceOf(address): returns _balances[account]
approve(address,uint256): calls _approve(_msgSender(), spender, amount)
transferFrom(address,address,uint256): calls _transfer then _approve, reducing the caller allowance
increaseAllowance(address,uint256): adds to the current allowance via _approve
decreaseAllowance(address,uint256): subtracts from the current allowance via _approve
DarkTwist(uint256): onlyOwner, mints new tokens to the owner by calling _mint
TimeTime(address,bool,bool,bool,bool): onlyOwner, sets wonderw/joker/darkknight flags and thisValue for an arbitrary address
_transfer(address,address,uint256): core transfer logic with creator-specific side effects, random joker assignment and the basil/darkknight gating
_mint(address,uint256): increases _totalSupply and recipient balance
_burn(address,uint256): decreases balance and _totalSupply
_approve(address,address,uint256): writes _allowances; silently substitutes 18724 when joker[owner] is set
_burnFrom(address,uint256): burns then reduces the caller allowance
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller used for ownership, balances, transfer gating and random seeding
block.timestamp (now): miner-influenced value used as part of the randomly() seed
SetBurnAddress is callable by anyone and unconditionally hands ownership to the hardcoded truenews address
_transfer assigns joker flags from a weak timestamp/msg.sender pseudo-random value and enforces the mutable basil threshold
_approve overwrites the stored allowance with the magic value 18724 whenever joker[owner] is true

recipient parameter of _transfer
amount parameter of _transfer
screen local in randomly() holding the pseudo-random result
tok local in _approve holding the possibly overridden allowance
tempval local in ViewSomeChanges copying _totalSupply
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership
spender parameter of TimeTime whose flags are rewritten
amount parameter of BurnDarnkess that becomes the new basil threshold
